_comment: Kemp eliminase motifs for RFD3. Ligand: 6NT = 6-nitrobenzotriazole, the stable transition-state ANALOGUE (a standard CCD ligand; works downstream in Boltz/AF3; crystal pose from PDB 4BS0 at 1.09 A). NOTE: the RFD3 native JSON format treats every key as a DesignInputSpecification field, so engine arguments (prevalidate_inputs, out_dir, ckpt_path, diffusion_batch_size) must be passed on the command line rather than in this file.
